language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hola! Welcome to my island. I am Alvita and this is my beach. Five ships came in with the tide yesterday. All the crews ran off and only the captains remained. Let’s say hi!
That’s Captain Crest of the Amphibians.
That’s Captain Reef of the Fish.
That’s Captain Cai of the Reptiles.
That’s Captain Black of the Mammals.
And that’s Captain Blue of the Birds.
They have a problem. They need to leave before the tide goes out again. They have asked me for help in finding a new crew.
Can you help them too? They are very picky though. Each captain wants to only use one type of animal for his crew. Let’s see if we can make them happy!
Welcome to Hideaway Island. Can you help the pirates find crews for their ships?

Alright, Captain Reef told me he wants a crew of fish like animals. But he’s confused by all these animals that live in and near the water.
He knows that some of them are not fish, even though they love water like the fish.
All fish have 5 characteristics in common: they breathe underwater with gills, are cold-blooded, have scales and fins, and lay lots of eggs.
Can you help me find the animals that have these characteristics?

Captain Black wants mammals for his crew. There are 5 things all mammals have in common:
1. hair or fur
2. give birth to live young
3. nurse their young with milk
4. lungs that are used to breathe in air
5. Warm-blooded
Warm-blooded means that animals keep the same temperature in hot and cold weather. Can you help Captain Black decide if these animals are mammals?

helperSimple.text: Captain Black is not sure whether his new recruits are mammals. Can you help Captain Black decide whether these recuits belong on his ship?

exercises.title: What makes birds and amphibians special?

dialog.text: Captain Crest and Captain Blue want amphibians and birds on their ships. Captain Crest looks for animals that have feathers and wings, lay hard-shelled eggs, have 2 legs, ear holes and are warm-blooded. He knows those are birds.

Captain Blue looks for animals that live on land and in water with moist smooth skin, have lungs and gills, 4 legs or none at all, and are cold-blooded. He knows those are amphibians. Can you explain to the ship captains how they are different from other animal groups?
